case.prompt: A vintage travel poster for CASABLANCA reading 'MEET ME AT SUNSET', bold geometric lettering.

production_40_step_remeasurement.artifact_policy: PNGs and logs remain in /private/tmp and are not committed

one_step_functional_smoke.scope: Temporary one-step diagnostic using the first timestep of the canonical 40-step schedule; it proves the full 1024 handoff and PNG shape, not image convergence.

vae_scratch_right_sizing.method: Size buffer_b and the preserved block shortcut for the 1024x1024x288 maximum; size the other four activation arenas for their 1024x1024x144 maximum.
vae_scratch_right_sizing.note: The first 4,973,395,968-byte sizing attempt under-allocated the block-4 norm1 buffer and was rejected by the 256 oracle. The corrected allocation gives that buffer its 288-channel maximum and passes both the 256 numerical oracle and a direct finite 1024 smoke. The full end-to-end timing above preceded this allocation-only change.

prior_correctness_evidence.scope: Pinned official BF16 reference gate for one complete 1024 noise prediction before the later MPS, SIMD normalization, submission, and fused-QKV optimizations. It is correctness evidence, not a current speed baseline.

interpretation.dominant_cost: The 654.686-second transformer loop accounts for 95.2% of end-to-end wall time. Quadratic 4096-token attention and production-shape transformer compute are therefore the first optimization target.
interpretation.cache_dit: Threshold 0.24 reached the same 27-of-40 cached-step count seen in the measured 256 case, but this 1024 prompt has no official end-to-end oracle. The coherent result is a product smoke observation, not an equivalence gate.
interpretation.resolution: The PNG encoder, transformer latent grid, scheduler, VAE decode, and host buffers all use the real 1024x1024 path; this is not an upscaled 256 image.

limitations: The original 2026-09-21 native section predates the official 40-step 1024 trajectory and decoded-image oracle; current oracle results are recorded in m1-max-1024-40-oracle.json.
Cache-DiT intentionally changes the denoising trajectory and remains opt-in.
The production remeasurement covers warm-filesystem fresh-process conditions; no reboot-cold repeat was made.
The original 2026-09-21 full run used the original 7.39 GB VAE scratch allocation; the corrected smaller allocation is used by the 2026-09-22 production remeasurement.
